top_signals.title: Disney Targets 20% Cost Savings in Thousands of Layoffs
top_signals.summary: Disney is planning thousands of job cuts and asking some managers to target 20% in annual cost savings that could come from job eliminations as well as from expense reductions, according to people familiar with the matter. Geetha Ranganathan of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
